issues.legal_issue: A minor family member’s proportionate share in joint family agricultural land does not entitle the minor to a separate ceiling area independent of the family’s ceiling entitlement.
material_facts: The claimant argued that, as a minor son with a proportionate share in joint family land, he was entitled to claim a separate ceiling area and that his share could not be combined with the land claimed by his father.
The High Court rejected that interpretation, and the claimant sought special leave to appeal.
The Supreme Court agreed with the High Court’s reasoning.
issues.conclusion: A minor son’s share in joint family land may be included with the land claimed by his father for the ceiling area; the minor is not entitled to a separate ceiling area independently.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 2(gg), 6(ii), and 7 of the Madhya Pradesh Ceiling on Agricultural Holdings Act, 1960, Section 6(ii) does not alter the ceiling area to which a family defined in Section 2(gg) is entitled under Section 7. A minor son deemed entitled to a proportionate share of joint family land under Section 6(ii) does not thereby obtain a separate ceiling area. The Court followed Begulla Bapi Raju etc. v. State of A.P. (1983) 2 Scale 141 and approved Sarjubai & Ors. v. State of M.P. & Ors. (Misc. Petition No. 811 of 1979).

rule.if: family_agricultural_ceiling_determination and claimant_is_minor_family_member and claimant_has_proportionate_share_in_joint_family_land and claimant_seeks_separate_ceiling_area

predicates.family_agricultural_ceiling_determinatio: The proceeding determines the ceiling area applicable to a family holding agricultural land.
predicates.claimant_is_minor_family_member: The claimant is a minor member of the family holding the agricultural land.
predicates.claimant_has_proportionate_share_in_join: The claimant is treated as having a proportionate share in land held jointly by the family.
predicates.claimant_seeks_separate_ceiling_area: The claimant seeks a separate ceiling area based on that share, independent of the area claimed by a parent.
predicates.minor_share_is_counted_with_parental_cei: The minor’s share in the joint family land is counted with the area claimed by a parent for ceiling purposes.

issues.definition: When a family agricultural ceiling determination concerns a minor family member who has a proportionate share in joint family land and seeks a separate ceiling area, the minor’s share is counted with the parental ceiling area.
